note: Modeled for study: routes follow real landmarks of this reference body but are not traced from a dissection.

levels.exit: Exits between the occipital bone and the atlas (C1), above the C1 vertebra.
levels.dermatome: No consistent dermatome (C1 is usually motor only).
levels.myotome: Small suboccipital muscles; with C2 forms ansa cervicalis (infrahyoids).

levels.exit: Exits above the C2 vertebra, through the foramen between C1 and C2.
levels.dermatome: Back of the scalp (occiput), angle of jaw region.

levels.exit: Exits above the C3 vertebra, through the foramen between C2 and C3.
levels.dermatome: Upper neck, below the occiput and jaw.

levels.exit: Exits above the C4 vertebra, through the foramen between C3 and C4.
levels.dermatome: Lower neck and a cape over the top of the shoulders and clavicles.

levels.exit: Exits above the C5 vertebra, through the foramen between C4 and C5.
levels.dermatome: Lateral (outer) upper arm over the deltoid; lateral elbow.
levels.myotome: Shoulder abduction (deltoid, supraspinatus), elbow flexion (biceps); diaphragm.

levels.exit: Exits above the C6 vertebra, through the foramen between C5 and C6.
levels.dermatome: Lateral forearm, thumb and radial side of index finger.
levels.myotome: Elbow flexion, wrist extension (extensor carpi radialis).

levels.exit: Exits above the C7 vertebra, through the foramen between C6 and C7.
levels.dermatome: Middle finger and the middle strip of the back of the forearm/hand.
levels.myotome: Elbow extension (triceps), wrist flexion, finger extension.

levels.exit: Exits between the C7 and T1 vertebrae (there is no C8 vertebra).
levels.dermatome: Ring and little fingers, ulnar side of hand and lower medial forearm.

levels.exit: Exits below the T1 vertebra, through the intervertebral foramen between T1 and T2.
levels.dermatome: Medial forearm and medial elbow.

levels.exit: Exits below the T2 vertebra, through the intervertebral foramen between T2 and T3.
levels.dermatome: Medial upper arm, axilla, upper chest below clavicle.
levels.myotome: Intercostals T2; sympathetic outflow to head (T1-T2).

levels.exit: Exits below the T3 vertebra, through the intervertebral foramen between T3 and T4.
levels.dermatome: Upper chest band.

levels.exit: Exits below the T4 vertebra, through the intervertebral foramen between T4 and T5.
levels.dermatome: Chest band at the nipple line.

levels.exit: Exits below the T5 vertebra, through the intervertebral foramen between T5 and T6.
levels.dermatome: Chest band below the nipples.

levels.exit: Exits below the T6 vertebra, through the intervertebral foramen between T6 and T7.
levels.dermatome: Band at the xiphoid process.

levels.exit: Exits below the T7 vertebra, through the intervertebral foramen between T7 and T8.
levels.dermatome: Band at the lower costal margin.
levels.myotome: Intercostal muscles of space 7; abdominal wall.

levels.exit: Exits below the T8 vertebra, through the intervertebral foramen between T8 and T9.
levels.dermatome: Upper abdominal band.
levels.myotome: Intercostal muscles of space 8; abdominal wall.

levels.exit: Exits below the T9 vertebra, through the intervertebral foramen between T9 and T10.
levels.dermatome: Abdominal band above the umbilicus.
levels.myotome: Intercostal muscles of space 9; abdominal wall.

levels.exit: Exits below the T10 vertebra, through the intervertebral foramen between T10 and T11.
levels.dermatome: Band at the umbilicus.

levels.exit: Exits below the T11 vertebra, through the intervertebral foramen between T11 and T12.
levels.dermatome: Lower abdominal band.
levels.myotome: Intercostal muscles of space 11; abdominal wall.

levels.exit: Exits below the T12 vertebra, through the intervertebral foramen between T12 and L1.
levels.dermatome: Band just above the inguinal ligament and pubis.

levels.exit: Exits below the L1 vertebra, through the intervertebral foramen between L1 and L2.
levels.dermatome: Groin, inguinal region and upper anterior thigh.

levels.exit: Exits below the L2 vertebra, through the intervertebral foramen between L2 and L3.
levels.dermatome: Anterior and medial thigh, upper half.

levels.exit: Exits below the L3 vertebra, through the intervertebral foramen between L3 and L4.
levels.dermatome: Lower anterior thigh and medial knee.

levels.exit: Exits below the L4 vertebra, through the intervertebral foramen between L4 and L5.
levels.dermatome: Medial leg, medial ankle (malleolus) and medial foot/big toe edge.

levels.exit: Exits below the L5 vertebra, through the intervertebral foramen between L5 and the sacrum (S1).
levels.dermatome: Lateral leg, dorsum of foot and toes 1-3 (first web space).
levels.myotome: Big-toe extension (extensor hallucis longus), hip abduction (gluteus medius).

levels.exit: Ventral ramus exits the S1 anterior sacral foramen (dorsal ramus via the posterior foramen).
levels.dermatome: Lateral foot, little toe, heel and lateral sole; lower posterior calf.
levels.myotome: Ankle plantarflexion (gastrocnemius/soleus), hip extension (gluteus maximus), foot eversion.

levels.exit: Ventral ramus exits the S2 anterior sacral foramen (dorsal ramus via the posterior foramen).
levels.dermatome: Posterior thigh and popliteal fossa, upper posterior calf.
levels.myotome: Toe flexion, plantar intrinsics; parasympathetic bladder (S2-S4).

levels.exit: Ventral ramus exits the S3 anterior sacral foramen (dorsal ramus via the posterior foramen).
levels.dermatome: Medial buttock and upper inner thigh (saddle).

levels.exit: Ventral ramus exits the S4 anterior sacral foramen (dorsal ramus via the posterior foramen).
levels.dermatome: Perineum (saddle area).
levels.myotome: Pelvic floor and external anal sphincter (pudendal S2-S4).

levels.exit: Exits through the sacral hiatus below the sacrum.
levels.dermatome: Skin immediately around the anus.

levels.exit: Exits through the sacral hiatus below the sacrum.
levels.dermatome: Small area over the coccyx.
